label: Will: the HAS_WILL_1 capacity versus a willed two-way giving
resolution: WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_1 is HAS_WILL_1 (DEF 7c64b499-6dba-5e03-bdf3-5acea95d8836), having will as a capacity, the sense of STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL. WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_2 (DEF de24ce2e-84e4-48d8-9cac-5f66ad532015) is exercise-level: a giving by a power classified Rational that is withheld at an accessible world with the same set-up (WilledTwoWayAt, the will-versus-chance batch). Sense 2 is unbridged to sense 1 except through the explicit OPEN bridges 'Whatever HAS_WILL_1 has a rational power' and 'Whatever has a rational power HAS_WILL_1', and it is unbridged to the Wills relation of statement a94c5dfc-c722-49fe-a242-dd39409b079d and to the exercise senses of disambiguation 941efd70-d56f-53f9-b5f9-8acd36711a54. No argument passes between the senses without one of those listed bridges.
